question: A garden starts with 54 plants. It loses 27 (27). It multiplies by 5 (135). It multiplies by 2 (270). It loses 155 (115). How many plants survive?

Fox and Grace track production. They start with 148 units. They multiply by 8 (1184). They multiply by 8 (9472). They add 4 (9476). They lose 6648 (2828). They multiply by 7 (19796). One distractor: competitor made 5000. How much do they produce?

A farm starts with 74 animals. In the morning, 7 leave (67). By afternoon, 55 arrive (122). By evening, 36 more come (158). They gain 78 (236). They gain 58 (294). At least double 50 would be 100. How many animals does the farm have?

A stock starts with 99 shares. It divides by 3 (33). It multiplies by 8 (264). It multiplies by 2 (528). It loses 267 (261). It loses 162 (99). Time converted from minutes to hours. Morning to afternoon to evening progression. How many shares remain?

A bakery starts with 66 loaves. In the morning, it divides by 3 (22). By afternoon, it multiplies by 9 (198). By evening, it multiplies by 8 (1584). It multiplies by 3 (4752). Time tracking from minutes to hours recorded. How many loaves are produced?

A recipe starts with 21 servings. It loses 8 (13). It multiplies by 5 (65). It multiplies by 2 (130). It adds 18 (148). It adds 73 (221). It loses 116 (105). Time measurement from minutes to hours included. How many servings?
A shop starts with 234 items. It doubles (468). It adds 64 (532). It adds 73 (605). It adds 7 (612). Half of 24 equals 12. How many items does it have?
A business starts with 113 units. It adds 44 (157). It adds 45 (202). It multiplies by 7 (1414). It multiplies by 7 (9898). It adds 65 (9963). It multiplies by 2 (19926). How many units?

A factory starts with 136 parts. It multiplies by 4 (544). It multiplies by 5 (2720). It adds 29 (2749). It loses 2012 (737). It multiplies by 7 (5159). One distractor: competitor made 2000. How many parts are produced?
A store starts with 32 items. It divides by 4 (8). It loses 3 (5). It loses 3 (2). It adds 80 (82). It divides by 2 (41). Half of 8 is 4. How many remain?
A schedule starts with 99 events. In the morning, 67 are canceled (32). By midday, 50 are rescheduled (82). By afternoon, 25 are moved (57). By evening, 12 are added (69). How many events remain?

A division starts with 138 units. It divides by 3 (46). It multiplies by 3 (138). It loses 34 (104). It loses 69 (35). Time from minutes to hours. One distractor: they had 55 overages. How many remain?
A warehouse starts with 212 units. It adds 52 (264). It adds 69 (333). It multiplies by 8 (2664). It multiplies by 9 (23976). It multiplies by 4 (95904). How many units total?

Dan and Eve run operations. They start with 43 units. They multiply by 8 (344). They lose 13 (331). They add 70 (401). They add 16 (417). They add 60 (477). They multiply by 8 (3816). Time from minutes to hours. How many units total?
A team starts with 192 items. It multiplies by 4 (768). It multiplies by 4 (3072). It adds 19 (3091). It loses 2108 (983). It loses 898 (85). How many items does the team have?
Lou and Maya track money. They start with 191 dollars. They add 8 (199). They lose 95 (104). They lose 94 (10). They add 76 (86). The team manages another account. How much do they track?

A shop starts with 172 items. It adds 57 (229). It multiplies by 6 (1374). It loses 1019 (355). It multiplies by 5 (1775). One distractor: competitor has 900. Time noted from minutes to hours. How many items?
An inventory starts with 235 units. It adds 57 (292). It loses 240 (52). It multiplies by 3 (156). It adds 30 (186). All stages track one quantity. How many units remain?
A vendor starts with 137 items. It adds 45 (182). It adds 65 (247). It loses 20 (227). It adds 78 (305). Half of 20 would be 10. One distractor: they used 34 yesterday. How many items does it have?
A maker starts with 37 items. It multiplies by 9 (333). It adds 44 (377). It multiplies by 7 (2639). It loses 377 (2262). It adds 52 (2314). Double of 26 is 52. How many items?
A garden starts with 41 plants. It multiplies by 9 (369). It adds 36 (405). It adds 44 (449). It loses 416 (33). It adds 10 (43). Half of 6 is 3. How many plants?
Ed and Ruth track funds. They start with 131 dollars. They add 75 (206). They add 43 (249). They add 42 (291). They add 67 (358). They lose 154 (204). Time: minutes to hours noted. How much money?

A project starts with 24 tasks. In the morning, dividing by 6 creates 4 per team. By afternoon, 5 are multiplied (20 per team). By evening, 2 are lost (18). It multiplies by 8 (144). How many task-units?

A farm starts with 84 animals. In the morning, 80 are moved (4). By midday, 2 are multiplied (doubled = 8). By afternoon, 3 times (24). By evening, 4 leave (20). By night, 3 more leave (17). Late, 3 final ones go (14). How many remain?
A workshop starts with 193 items. It adds 64 (257). It multiplies by 4 (1028). It loses 92 (936). It adds 66 (1002). It loses 481 (521). One distractor: they sold 77 yesterday. How many items?
